verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents CHKit, a first-party tool with typed commands to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code, explicitly positioned as something "an agent can drive, in CI" with a reviewable diff. The service also exposes the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so any client or driver can query it headlessly. Missing for 10: in-depth CHKit/CLI reference docs or CI pipeline examples, a documented programmatic API for provisioning and managing clusters headlessly, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
